question: Does an item-level final-label, judge, adjudication, or refutation ledger exist for the frozen 100-item matcher false-negative sample?
conclusion: No such ledger was found. The 100 complete source item records and the aggregate 8/5/87 audit survive, but the mapping from fn001..fn100 to final adjudication labels does not.

sources.description: The frozen generation, execution, and matcher codebase together with its complete result trees.
content_candidates_ruled_out: The E1 engineering-validity/contamination pilot ledger (different item population and purpose, not the matcher FN sample).
The E1/T4 engineering-validity audit files (different item population and purpose).

sources.description: The manuscript working directory in which the historical P0-1 matcher audit outputs were produced.
relevant_filename_candidates: the historical 100-item sample export, published here byte-exact as audit/matcher_fn/p01_fn_samples_legacy_truncated.json
the historical aggregate audit summary, published here byte-exact as audit/matcher_fn/P01_false_negative_audit.json
a drafted manuscript paragraph describing the audit (prose only)
sources.candidate_disposition: The sample export has fn001..fn100 and submitted record fields but no label, judge, or refutation field; the aggregate audit has only final counts and breakdowns; the drafted paragraph is prose. None of the three carries a per-item adjudication label.

history_search.scope: All reachable branches and reflog-visible history of both sources were searched, not only their current working trees.
history_search.upstream_pipeline_sample_id_hits: None: the fn001..fn100 sample identifiers never appear in the history of the upstream experimental pipeline.
history_search.working_record_hits: A single historical commit introducing exactly the two candidate exports named above (the sample export and the aggregate audit summary); no third matcher-adjudication file accompanied them.
history_search.result: Reachable branches and reflog-visible history exposed no fourth matcher-adjudication artifact.

search_commands: recursive filename search of both sources filtered on matcher/audit/judge/adjudication/refutation/label terms
recursive content search for the sample identifiers and audit keys listed above over both working trees
history-wide content search (all branches plus reflog) for the same terms, reporting the paths that introduced or removed them
reproducibility_boundary: Do not infer per-item labels from aggregate stratum totals. A new readjudication would be a new versioned audit, not recovery of the historical ledger.
